description: Organic web search results from the Brave Search API (an independent web index, not Google's): rank, title, URL, snippet, site name, page age and language for the first page of results. Optional country and freshness filters. No ads or SERP features. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Optional 2-letter country for local results, e.g. us, gb, de

freshness.description: Optional: pd (past day), pw (past week), pm (past month), py (past year)

name: search_google_search
title: Search Google Search
